rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happens throughout the country.

example.traditional: 呢項優惠喺全國各地都有得用。
example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 jau1 wai6 hai2 cyun4 gwok3 gok3 dei6 dou1 jau5 dak1 jung6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something extending across the whole country, especially in everyday speech.

example.traditional: 呢間超市嘅優惠全國都有。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 si5 ge3 jau1 wai6 cyun4 gwok3 dou1 jau5

rows.note: Use this more formal adjective when explicitly describing an event, issue, or organization as national in scope.

example.english: This is a nationwide public-welfare event.
example.traditional: 呢個係一場全國性嘅公益活動。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 jat1 coeng4 cyun4 gwok3 sing3 ge3 gung1 jik1 wut6 dung6
